description: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC): wildfire hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). Coverage: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wildfire hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Clasificación de tamaños de incendios forestales (ISTAC: CL_TAMANIOS_I; Clasificación de causas de incendios forestales (ISTAC: CL_CAUSAS_INCE; Clasificación de tipos de superficie de incendios forestales (ISTAC: C. Formats seen: JSON, CSV, XML, SHEET. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.gobiernodecanarias.org/istac/aviso_legal.html). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
